messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks slowly forward away from the camera, her arms swinging gently at her sides.","camera":"A medium shot from behind the character, tracking forward at a steady pace to keep her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting dress with a black-and-white houndstooth pattern, featuring a low open back and cold-shoulder cutouts at the sleeves.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair is pulled back into a low bun with two small, rounded buns or pigtails at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A slender female character with fair skin, seen from behind with her face not visible.","scene":"An outdoor paved road or bridge area on a sunny day, with green trees, a metal guardrail, a street lamp, and a clear blue sky with light clouds."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a stone terrace overlooking the sea to a paved road with guardrails, trees, a street lamp, and a building, matching the reference. The character remains the same blonde woman in the houndstooth dress, walking away from the camera in a similar medium rear tracking shot.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside scene with the reference road environment and its lighting, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the new lighting on the character exactly matches the reference image's lighting
unexpected_changes: The character's shadow now appears on the road, consistent with the new lighting but not present in the source
